title: Seven-day family meal plan
description: A visual weekly meal plan fixture with household constraints, batch preparation, reuse, shopping, and safety notes.
content: Seven-day family meal plan with recipe cards, a schedule, batch preparation, shopping checklist, and food safety notes.

metadata.subtitle: A practical seven-day plan with image-linked meals and one consolidated shop.

blocks.title: A calm week of shared dinners
blocks.subtitle: Five cooked dinners, two flexible leftover nights, and one batch-prep window for a four-person household.

media.alt: Seven labeled day containers arranged around fresh vegetables on a kitchen table
media.credit: Synthetic fixture illustration generated for Cognis visual QA

blocks.title: Plan constraints
blocks.content: Nut free. One adult eats vegetarian meals; poultry and fish stay optional. Keep Tuesday and Thursday under 35 minutes.

items.title: Lemon chickpea traybake
items.description: Make extra roast vegetables for Tuesday.

items.title: Fish tacos or bean tacos
items.description: Choose the household protein at serving time.

items.title: Soup and focaccia
items.description: Use freezer bread and remaining greens.

items.title: Flexible leftovers
items.description: Finish safely chilled portions before cooking more.

blocks.title: Recipe cards
blocks.subtitle: Each image belongs to the meal card it previews; no detached image gallery.

blocks.title: Lemon chickpea traybake
blocks.summary: Chickpeas, carrots, peppers, lemon, and yogurt. Reserve two cups of vegetables.

media.alt: Lemon chickpea traybake with peppers and carrots
media.credit: Synthetic fixture illustration generated for Cognis visual QA

blocks.title: Tomato lentil pasta
blocks.summary: Red lentils make a fast sauce. Freeze half only after it has cooled.

media.alt: Tomato lentil pasta with basil in a shallow bowl
media.credit: Synthetic fixture illustration generated for Cognis visual QA

blocks.title: Fish or bean tacos
blocks.summary: Serve flaky white fish and spiced beans separately for an easy vegetarian option.

media.alt: Three tacos with cabbage, lime, beans, and fish options
media.credit: Synthetic fixture illustration generated for Cognis visual QA

items.title: Wash and cut
items.content: Wash produce. Cut carrots, peppers, onions, and cabbage. Store dry vegetables in sealed containers.

items.title: Cook the base
items.content: Cook rice and lentil sauce. Cool both in shallow containers before refrigeration.

items.title: Label the portions
items.content: Label Monday vegetables, Wednesday sauce, and Friday taco fillings with the planned day.

blocks.alt: Labeled meal-prep containers with chopped vegetables, rice, and lentil sauce
blocks.caption: One 75-minute batch session reduces work on the two shortest evenings.
blocks.credit: Synthetic fixture illustration generated for Cognis visual QA

blocks.title: Leftover rule
blocks.content: Plan the leftover dinner for Sunday. Refrigerate cooked food within two hours and use it within three days.

checklist.title: Chickpeas, red lentils, rice, pasta, tortillas

blocks.title: Allergen note
blocks.content: The plan contains wheat, dairy, egg, soy options, and fish on Friday. Keep fish utensils and cutting boards separate from vegetarian fillings.

blocks.title: Food safety
blocks.content: Keep raw fish below ready-to-eat food in the refrigerator. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot, and do not reheat them more than once.
